# Magik

> An opinionated, full-stack Ruby framework on TruffleRuby, and an **AI-first repository**: the primary developer is an AI agent, and every design decision follows from that. One uniform DSL grammar covers models, screens, actions, realtime channels, background jobs, ledgers, APIs and admin panels — a `ledger` is declared the way a `model` is, so there is one grammar to learn and one to hold in context. The server renders HTML and htmx handles interactivity; there is no SPA framework and never will be. Conventions are enforced at boot rather than documented: an unbalanced ledger, a `field :card_number`, a cross-domain reach, a screen holding state, a timestamp with no timezone — each is a boot failure carrying a stable `MAGIK_*` code, a one-sentence cause and a runnable `fix:` line, which is the correction signal an agent can act on without a human in the loop. Multi-tenant by default, UUIDv7 keys, integer-cents money, and a config-level swap behind every opinionated default. The CLI binary is `magik`. Install with `gem install magik`.

This file is a link map, not a status page. **It states no version, count or verdict without the command that resolves it** — a number written here goes stale on the next commit and the command does not. `As of 2026-08-26`.

**The one fact you must not get wrong:** `magik 0.0.1` is a **name reservation on RubyGems**. No framework code exists. Every DSL block in `wiki/` and `docs/` is a design artefact that has never been parsed. Two CLI commands run — `version` and `help` — and everything else exits `1` with `MAGIK_COMMAND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED`. Resolve it with `magik help --json` before you quote anything else on this page.

## Which reader are you

Two different jobs, two different starting points. Pick one before reading further.

**A — You are implementing Magik.** You are writing framework code in this repository, landing a phase, adding a subsystem.

- [docs/idea/00-build-spec.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/00-build-spec.md) — the specification, kept verbatim. The source of truth. Nothing contradicts it.
- [docs/idea/06-phases.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/06-phases.md) — the nine phases in detail, and what "done" means for each.
- [ROADMAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/ROADMAP.md) — the twelve-step build order, the version milestones, and today's status.
- [docs/architecture/05-adding-a-feature.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/05-adding-a-feature.md) — the end-to-end loop with the exact command per step. Read this one most.
- [.claude/commands/implement-phase.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/implement-phase.md) — the slash command that lands a phase. Delivery here is agent-driven and gated by `bin/check`.
- [.claude/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/README.md) — the whole workbench: subagents and commands.

**B — You are building a SaaS with Magik.** You are writing app code — models, screens, actions. **Nothing works yet**; the wiki is the target DSL, not a usable API.

- [wiki/Home.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Home.md) — the reference manual index.
- [wiki/Getting-Started.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Getting-Started.md) — the intended first run, end to end.
- [wiki/Models.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Models.md) · [wiki/Screens-And-Components.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Screens-And-Components.md) · [wiki/Actions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Actions.md) — the three declarations most app code is made of.
- [wiki/Project-Layout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Project-Layout.md) — where every file goes, and the filename ↔ declaration mapping in both directions. Read before writing a path.
- [wiki/Testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Testing.md) — the test DSL, inferred factories, the helpers, the parallel runner.
- [dummy/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/dummy/README.md) — the invoicing/billing demo SaaS, following the canonical layout. Empty today.
- [docs/idea/09-app-scaffold.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/09-app-scaffold.md) — the AI harness `magik new` is meant to put in your app: `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `llms.txt`, `.claude/agents` and `.claude/commands`, `docs/`, and which of them a regeneration may rewrite. The templates it describes: [lib/magik/cli/templates/app/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/lib/magik/cli/templates/app/README.md). Whether `magik new` runs yet: `magik help --json`.

Both readers: [wiki/Error-Codes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md) and [wiki/Known-Gaps.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Known-Gaps.md).

## Resolve before you quote

- `gem list magik --remote --all`: what RubyGems actually serves. The published version is a name reservation; do not infer capability from it.
- `ruby -Ilib -e 'require "magik"; puts Magik::VERSION'`: what this checkout is stamped at.
- `ruby -Ilib -e 'require "magik"; puts Magik::SUBSYSTEMS.keys.inspect'`: every planned subsystem, from the map that drives autoloading. The authoritative list — not the copy in any document.
- `magik version --json` / `magik help --json`: the two commands that run, and the registry of every command with its status. **The authoritative answer to "what works".**
- `rake -T`: every task this checkout defines. What the repo can do, as opposed to what it plans to.
- `bin/check`: the gate — lint, tests, doc checks. Green means the change is landable.
- `bundle exec yard stats --list-undoc`: documentation coverage of what exists. Published at <https://developerz-ai.github.io/magik/api/>.

## Where do I look for X

- **What is Magik supposed to be**: [docs/idea/00-build-spec.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/00-build-spec.md). Verbatim spec, nine phases, twelve build steps. Everything else elaborates on it.
- **Why the repo is arranged for an agent**: [docs/idea/07-ai-first.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/07-ai-first.md), then [.claude/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/README.md).
- **What actually works today**: `magik help --json`, then [wiki/Known-Gaps.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Known-Gaps.md). The answer is "two commands".
- **Where does this file go**: [wiki/Project-Layout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Project-Layout.md) — one predictable mapping from filename to declaration, both directions, plus what each directory must not hold.
- **What shape does a declaration take**: [docs/idea/02-dsl-surface.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/02-dsl-surface.md) for the canonical form; the `wiki/` page for the reference version with a worked example.
- **Why is this a boot failure**: [docs/idea/03-guardrails.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/03-guardrails.md). Six spec guardrails, each a boot failure by design.
- **Can I replace a default**: [docs/idea/04-swap-points.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/04-swap-points.md) — DB, cache, jobs, search, realtime. Every swap needs a passing test on both sides before it is claimed. None exists yet.
- **Can I use my own components**: [docs/idea/08-component-overrides.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/08-component-overrides.md) for the reasoning; [wiki/Screens-And-Components.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Screens-And-Components.md) for the four-rung ladder, the kit contract and the resolution order.
- **What will it refuse to do**: [docs/idea/05-limits.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/05-limits.md). No offline, no heavy client-side compute, no SPA framework. Permanent, not a gap.
- **I hit a `MAGIK_*` code**: [wiki/Error-Codes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md). Run the `fix:` line verbatim — it is a command or an edit naming a file. Four codes are real; the rest are seeded from the guardrails and raised by nothing.
- **A CLI flag, a `--json` shape, an exit code**: [wiki/CLI-Reference.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/CLI-Reference.md).
- **Which module owns this**: [docs/architecture/01-module-map.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/01-module-map.md). **What may depend on what**: [docs/architecture/02-boundaries.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/02-boundaries.md).
- **How the tests are meant to run**: [docs/architecture/04-testing-strategy.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/04-testing-strategy.md) for the mechanism and its risks; [wiki/Testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Testing.md) for what you type.
- **Why is my change not reloading**: [wiki/Development-Loop.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Development-Loop.md), then [docs/architecture/08-dev-loop.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/08-dev-loop.md).
- **Where do secrets and env vars come from**: [docs/architecture/07-configuration-and-secrets.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/07-configuration-and-secrets.md).
- **How do I see what a running app is doing**: [docs/architecture/06-observability.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/06-observability.md).
- **How to run it in production**: [docs/ops/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/ops/README.md). Recommendations only.
- **The rules I must not break while editing this repo**: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/CLAUDE.md) and [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/AGENTS.md); the coding contract is [docs/architecture/00-conventions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/00-conventions.md).
- **How to cut a release**: [PUBLISHING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/PUBLISHING.md), then [.claude/commands/release.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/release.md).

## The agent workbench — .claude

Committed to the tree rather than kept in a local config, because the repo's way of working is part of the repo. A phase is landed by an agent running `/implement-phase` and gated by `bin/check`.

- [.claude/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/README.md): what is here and when to reach for it.
- Subagents: [spec-implementer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/agents/spec-implementer.md) · [dsl-designer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/agents/dsl-designer.md) · [guardrail-author](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/agents/guardrail-author.md) · [docs-keeper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/agents/docs-keeper.md) · [test-writer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/agents/test-writer.md) · [swap-point-prover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/agents/swap-point-prover.md)
- Commands: [/implement-phase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/implement-phase.md) · [/next-task](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/next-task.md) · [/check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/check.md) · [/new-dsl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/new-dsl.md) · [/spec-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/spec-audit.md) · [/release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/.claude/commands/release.md)

## The phases

Nine spec phases, delivered in a twelve-step build order that is deliberately **not** the same sequence: testing is spec Phase 9 and build step 5, so everything after it is test-driven; the API phase lands after auth/billing/admin because the admin panel is the first real consumer of the resource DSL. Definitions of "done" and version milestones: [ROADMAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/ROADMAP.md). **All nine are planned. None is built.**

| Phase | Ships | Reference page |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Foundation | `App.define`, `model`, `migrate`, `:money`, UUIDv7, tenant injection, CLI | [wiki/Models.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Models.md) |
| 2 Rendering & actions | `component`, `screen`, `action`, the kit, theming, router, hot reload | [wiki/Screens-And-Components.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Screens-And-Components.md) · [wiki/Actions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Actions.md) |
| 3 Realtime | `live`, `channel`, `broadcast`, `presence` — opt-in per screen | [wiki/Realtime.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Realtime.md) |
| 4 Jobs | `job`, retries, schedules, the transactional queue, `magik worker` | [wiki/Jobs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Jobs.md) |
| 5 Money & compliance | `ledger`, `audited`, `immutable_after:`, `idempotent_by`, `flow` | [wiki/Money-And-Ledgers.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Money-And-Ledgers.md) |
| 6 API & integration | `api`, `resource`, incoming and outgoing `webhook`, API auth, rate limits | [wiki/API-And-Webhooks.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/API-And-Webhooks.md) |
| 7 Auth, billing, admin | `auth`, `billing`, `admin_panel`, `tenant_by` | [wiki/Auth-Billing-Admin.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Auth-Billing-Admin.md) |
| 8 i18n, PWA, notifications | `locales`, `translatable:`, `pwa`, `notification` | [wiki/Home.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Home.md) |
| 9 Testing (built 3rd) | the `test` DSL, inferred factories, the helpers, the parallel runner | [wiki/Testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Testing.md) |
| + Domains | `domain`, boot-time boundary enforcement, `magik check --scale` | [wiki/Domains.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Domains.md) |

## The guardrails

The product **is** the enforcement. Six things fail at boot, each with a code, a cause and a runnable `fix:` — which is the correction signal an agent acts on. Full reasoning: [docs/idea/03-guardrails.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/03-guardrails.md). Full catalogue: [wiki/Error-Codes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md).

- Ledger entries must balance — `MAGIK_LEDGER_UNBALANCED`
- No PAN-shaped field may exist — `MAGIK_PAN_FIELD_FORBIDDEN`
- No cross-domain direct model access — `MAGIK_DOMAIN_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION`
- No in-process state across requests in a screen or action — `MAGIK_STATEFUL_SCREEN`
- No timestamp rendered without an explicit timezone — `MAGIK_TIMEZONE_UNSPECIFIED`
- No query without `tenant_id` in its `WHERE` — `MAGIK_TENANT_SCOPE_MISSING`, via `magik check --scale`

Rendered shape, identical in the terminal, the development error page and `--json` — it is one object, `Magik::Error#to_h`:

```text
MAGIK_LEDGER_UNBALANCED: entry :invoice_issued debits 14999, credits 14900
  fix: correct the amounts in app/ledgers/receivables.rb — debits must equal credits
```

Four codes exist today, all in the CLI: `MAGIK_ERROR`, `MAGIK_UNKNOWN_COMMAND`, `MAGIK_COMMAND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, `MAGIK_INVALID_OPTION`. Every other code on the catalogue page is seeded from the guardrails and raised by nothing.

## The limits

Permanent exclusions, not gaps. They are refusals with codes rather than silent no-ops, because a limit that fails quietly is worse than one that refuses loudly. Full detail: [docs/idea/05-limits.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/idea/05-limits.md).

- **No offline support.** The server is the single source of truth — `MAGIK_OFFLINE_UNSUPPORTED`.
- **No heavy client-side compute.** Canvas editors, games, in-browser media editing — `MAGIK_CLIENT_COMPUTE_UNSUPPORTED`.
- **No SPA framework, ever.** React/Vue/Svelte owning rendering is forbidden; attaching your own JavaScript behaviour to server-rendered markup is not.
- **No GraphQL.** REST, generated from `resource` declarations. A second query language is a second authorization surface.
- **CRuby is not the target.** TruffleRuby is production; CRuby `>= 3.2` is for tooling. Where they diverge, TruffleRuby is documented behaviour.
- **Not a multi-gem monorepo.** One gem, subsystem modules under `lib/magik/`. Extraction stays possible; it is not promised.

- [08-dev-loop.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/architecture/08-dev-loop.md): how hot reload works, and what it cannot reload.

### Operations — docs/ops

- [Operations index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/docs/ops/README.md): running a Magik app for real. Recommendations only; the framework depends on none of it.

### The reference manual — wiki

The public documentation surface. Source of truth is `wiki/` in this repository, browsable at <https://github.com/developerz-ai/magik/wiki>. Every page carries a `Status:` line and documents **intended** behaviour.

- [Home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Home.md): the index, with a reading path per audience.
- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Installation.md): TruffleRuby as the production target, CRuby 3.2+ for tooling, and what `gem install magik` actually gives you today.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Getting-Started.md): the intended first run — `magik new` → `bin/setup` → `magik server`.
- [Development loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Development-Loop.md): hot reload, the console, generators, `--watch`, the error page. No JS build step, ever.
- [Project layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Project-Layout.md): the annotated tree, the filename ↔ declaration mapping both directions, how it scales to domains, and generated versus hand-written.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/CLI-Reference.md): every command, flag, `--json` shape and exit code, with the two that run today marked.
- [Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Models.md): `model`, `migrate`, field types, tenancy, UUIDv7, the Sequel seam.
- [Screens and components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Screens-And-Components.md): `screen`, `component`, the kit, theming, and the four-rung override ladder for your own components.
- [Actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Actions.md): the only thing that mutates. Params, guards, routing by convention, idempotency.
- [Realtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Realtime.md): `live`, `channel`, `broadcast`, `presence` — opt-in per screen, and free when undeclared.
- [Jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Jobs.md): the only thing that runs async. The transactional queue, retries, schedules.
- [Money and ledgers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Money-And-Ledgers.md): integer cents, double-entry, audit, immutability, idempotency, flows.
- [API and webhooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/API-And-Webhooks.md): `api`, `resource`, incoming and outgoing webhooks, API auth, plan-based rate limits.
- [Auth, billing, admin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Auth-Billing-Admin.md): Rodauth-backed auth, Stripe billing, generated admin panels, `tenant_by`.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Testing.md): the `test` DSL over Minitest, every helper in use, inferred factories, generated tests, all cores by default.
- [Domains](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Domains.md): `depends_on`, `exposes`, `publishes_events`, and boot-time boundary enforcement.
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md): the format contract, the four live codes, and the catalogue seeded from the guardrails.
- [Known gaps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Known-Gaps.md): the honest page. The gap is the entire framework.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/FAQ.md): why TruffleRuby, why Sequel, why Minitest, why htmx, why no offline, is it production ready, how it differs from Rails.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/magik/main/wiki/Contributing.md): a pointer to the root guide.
